body.en:
## What your free eye check covers
Your eyecare professional will test your vision and look at how your eyes cope with screen work. Read our guide to [screen time and your eyes](/sg/en/articles/screen-time-and-your-eyes) or see our [lenses for office work](/sg/en/products/office-lenses).

## How to book
Choose a partner store and a time that suits you. The offer runs from 1 to 31 December 2026.
